6.404 rsInvalidScopeReference
Applies to RDL 2012/01
rsInvalidScopeReference is a critical error that occurs when there is an expression that has an invalid
reference to a Scope in a Global.Scopes collection. Scope references can refer only to a DataSet that
has a DefaultRelationship to the DataSet that is bound to the current scope or the DataSet that is
bound to a parent scope.
